name: My Monster
source:
My Monster is an adults-only visual novel about Samuel Hart, an anxious man finally making the big leap: moving in with his soon-to-be-not-so-long-distance-anymore boyfriend—the big and friendly Sullivan, a monster who wears his heart on his sleeve. With Samuel settling in, and Sullivan off work for a few days, the two make the most out of their first few days of cohabitation. Follow the couple as they hit up the town, go shopping, visit the city, relax under the stars, and more!

[From [url=https://shutterafterdark.itch.io/my-monster]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《我的怪物》是一部仅限成人观看的视觉小说，讲述的是塞缪尔·哈特，一个焦虑的男人终于迈出了一大步：和他即将不再异地恋的男友——大而友好的沙利文住在一起，沙利文是一个把自己的心藏在袖子里的怪物。塞缪尔安顿下来，沙利文下班了几天，两人充分利用了同居的最初几天。跟随这对夫妇前往小镇、购物、参观这座城市、在星空下放松等等！

[来自[url=https://shutterafterdark.itch.io/my-monster]Itch.io[/url]]
